paragraphs.text: Giraffe is a creature type used for cards that depict a species of large hoofed mammals with elongated necks. It was introduced in Secrets of Strixhaven with Hungry Graffalon .
Giraffes are known to exist on Fiora , Capenna , and in Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun . Girrafids are also known on Ikoria ( Flycatcher Giraffid ).
